meta.aiUse: Built by pipeline code written with AI assistance (Claude Code), directed and reviewed by the team. See AI_USE.md.
meta.description: Monthly climate normals for every site in analogs.json and the extra sites of sites.json. Each value is that of the source grid cell containing the site, not a measurement at the site.

fields.label: Mean temperature
fields.source: NASA POWER monthly climatology 2001-2020, parameter T2M, grid 0.5 x 0.625 degrees (MERRA-2)

fields.label: Day-night temperature range
fields.source: NASA POWER monthly climatology 2001-2020, parameter T2M_RANGE, grid 0.5 x 0.625 degrees (MERRA-2)

fields.label: Precipitation
fields.source: NASA POWER monthly climatology 2001-2020, parameter PRECTOTCORR, grid 0.5 x 0.625 degrees (MERRA-2)
fields.note: mm/day from the source times the days in the month (February 28.25).

fields.label: Surface solar irradiance (all sky, horizontal, 24 h mean)
fields.source: NASA POWER monthly climatology 2001-2020, parameter ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, grid 1 x 1 degree (CERES SYN1deg)
